limits: Two actual native CLIs on one Apple Silicon Mac; exact byte oracles, LF-only line delimiter (CR retained), empty-input/query contracts, split writes, descriptor and budget failures. These are bounded local application tests, not evidence of live production log incidents, Unicode normalization, general security, concurrency, PDF extraction or speed superiority.
